text:
Maria G.: heads-up: proposing an opt-in 'Minimize PII' toggle in Route Settings to reduce logged sensitive material for sampled request/response captures. Want quick thumbs before I open RFC.

Jin Park: does toggle affect sampling or just redaction post-sample?

Maria G.: only post-sample redaction and adds a small pii_risk tag so dashboard can show why something was redacted. sampling quotas unchanged.

Aaron L.: reminder: embeddings hashed then stored still allow similarity probes. we must avoid storing raw vectors or reversible transforms.

Priya S.: idea: embeddings pipeline -> L2 norm -> 8-bit quantize -> tenant-HMAC -> store only HMAC + risk. that prevents reuse and reduces size.

Dee (SRE): ops: per-tenant HMAC means KMS pressure. plan to cache key handles, metrics for kms.calls and cache.hits. fallback to ephemeral local key for dev canaries.

Maria G.: noted. Add metrics and circuit-breaker if KMS errors spike.

ops-bot: rollout scheduled: canary route=/v1/embeddings/* pct=5 flag=pii_minimize

Jin Park: UX: default OFF. add explanatory tooltip: "Minimize PII (sampled captures only) — reduces logged content at cost of reduced debug visibility."

Aaron L.: add audit entry when toggle flips: actor, route, old/new, canary id. no sensitive payloads in audit.

Priya S.: telemetry stub so we can iterate: {"route":"/v1/embeddings/text", "pii_risk":"low", "redaction":"hmac-v1", "sampled": true}

Dee (SRE): perf check: if HMAC >20ms we need batching or async workers. I'll bench Wed.

Maria G.: action items: I will draft RFC + dashboard mock, Priya mock telemetry, Dee bench HMAC perf, Jin write copy. target canary next week. :thumbsup:
